arxiv-1905-10009.title: Not All Features Are Equal: Feature Leveling Deep Neural Networks for Better Interpretation
arxiv-1905-10009.creator: Yingjing Lu*, Runde Yang*
arxiv-1905-10009.description: Abstract Self-explaining models are models that reveal decision making parameters in an interpretable manner so that the model reasoning process can be directly understood by human beings. General Linear Models (GLMs) are self-explaining because the model weights directly show how each feature contributes to the output value.

arxiv-2212-13622.title: A Statistical Inquiry into Gender-Based Income Inequality in Canada
arxiv-2212-13622.creator: Ali R. Kaazempur-Mofrad, Faculty of Arts & Sciences, University of Toronto
arxiv-2212-13622.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ali R. Kaazempur-Mofrad, Faculty of Arts & Sciences, University of Toronto. Abstract Income inequality distribution between social groups has been a global challenge. The focus of this study is to investigate the potential impact of female income on family size and purchasing power. Using statistical methods such as simple linear regression, maximum likelihood analysis, and hypothesis testing, I evaluated and investigated the variability of female pre-tax income with respect to family size.

arxiv-2307-02494.title: Comparison of Neural FEM and Neural Operator Methods for applications in Solid Mechanics
arxiv-2307-02494.creator: Stefan Hildebrand, Sandra Klinge
arxiv-2307-02494.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Stefan Hildebrand, Sandra Klinge. Machine Learning methods belong to the group of most up-to-date approaches for solving partial differential equations. The current work investigates two classes, Neural FEM and Neural Operator Methods, for the use in elastostatics by means of numerical experiments. The Neural Operator methods require expensive training but then allow for solving multiple boundary value problems with the same Machine Learning model. Main differences between the two classes are the computational effort and accuracy.

arxiv-2404-09059.title: Prevalence estimation methods for time-dependent antibody kinetics of infected and vaccinated individuals: a graph-theoretic approach
arxiv-2404-09059.creator: Prajakta Bedekar, Rayanne A. Luke, Anthony J. Kearsley
arxiv-2404-09059.description: Abstract Immune events such as infection, vaccination, and a combination of the two result in distinct time-dependent antibody responses in affected individuals. These responses and event prevalences combine non-trivially to govern antibody levels sampled from a population. Time-dependence and disease prevalence pose considerable modeling challenges that need to be addressed to provide a rigorous mathematical underpinning of the underlying biology.

arxiv-2406-00995.description: Abstract . We introduce the space of mixed-volume forms endowed with an L 2 L^{2} metric on a balanced manifold. A geodesic equation can be derived in this space that has an interesting structure and extends the equation of Donaldson [ 16 ] and Chen-He [ 6 ] in the space of volume forms on a Riemannian manifold.

arxiv-2409-04714.title: Unleashing the Power of Generic Segmentation Models: A Simple Baseline for Infrared Small Target Detection
arxiv-2409-04714.creator: Mingjin Zhang, Chi Zhang, Qiming Zhang, Yunsong Li, Xinbo Gao, Jing Zhang
arxiv-2409-04714.description: Abstract . Recent advancements in deep learning have greatly advanced the field of infrared small object detection (IRSTD). Despite their remarkable success, a notable gap persists between these IRSTD methods and generic segmentation approaches in natural image domains. This gap primarily arises from the significant modality differences and the limited availability of infrared data.

arxiv-2511-14689.title: Impact of Image Resolution on Age Estimation with DeepFace and InsightFace
arxiv-2511-14689.creator: Shiyar Jamo
arxiv-2511-14689.description: Abstract Automatic age estimation is widely used for age verification, where input images often vary considerably in resolution. This study evaluates the effect of image resolution on age estimation accuracy using DeepFace and InsightFace. A total of 1000 images from the IMDB-Clean dataset were processed in seven resolutions, resulting in 7000 test samples.

arxiv-2512-16280.description: Abstract Romance-baiting scams have become a major source of financial and emotional harm worldwide. pmc-10738744.creator: Yuka Shichijo, Fred Ko, Renee Slon, Nisha Rughwani, Yuji Yamada
pmc-10738744.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundFalls and fall-related injuries are major public health concerns. Approximately 50 billion dollars are spent on annual medical costs related to falls. Fall prevention is a priority for promoting active and healthy aging in older adults. Fall prevention clinics enable focused evaluation, identification, and treatment of modifiable risk factors, specifically for falls; however, their effectiveness is dependent upon patient adherence to preventive interventions.MethodsWe analyzed patients aged > 65 years who visited our fall clinic between February 2021 and February 2023.

pmc-12462528.title: Molecular basis of ParA ATPase activation by the CTPase ParB during bacterial chromosome segregation
pmc-12462528.creator: Lucas Schnabel, Manuel Osorio-Valeriano, Cecilia Perez-Borrajero, Wieland Steinchen, Christopher-Nils Mais, Bernd Simon, Juri Hanßmann, Maria Thamm, Janosch Hennig, Gert Bange, Martin Thanbichler
pmc-12462528.description: DNA segregation by bacterial ParABS systems is mediated by transient tethering interactions between nucleoid-bound dimers of the ATPase ParA and centromere (parS)-associated complexes of the clamp-forming CTPase ParB. The lifetime of these interactions is limited by the ParB-dependent activation of ParA ATPase activity. Here, we elucidate the functional interplay between ParA and ParB in the model bacterium Myxococcus xanthus.

pmc-12771411.description: Dual-labeled, profluorescent chemical probes have been developed to quantify and visualize a specific enzyme’s activity in complex biological media. The intact chemical probes often exhibit minimal fluorescence due to fluorescence quenching, but their intrinsic fluorescence can be released by a favorable enzyme-catalyzed reaction. Contact quenching represents one of several fluorescence quenching mechanisms.
